title.narrative: Accelerating the implementation of prevention services and quality care in the fight against the epidemics of HIV and TB - Togo (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Togo, HIV, Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement (SGG)This program has the following goals: Decrease HIV morbidity and mortality by intensifying good quality treatment for PLHA (children and adults). Mitigate the risks of transmission of STIs and HIV in vulnerable areas (KAPs)
